title: Gettysburg field map
note: lat/lng are real battlefield and downtown geography. Sample ticket office is a concept pin, not a live storefront. Sage: ACF area_map / CPT area_place.

places.title: Lincoln Square
places.blurb: The civic heart of downtown Gettysburg. The lantern walk uses a sample downtown meet at the flagpole — tour geography, not a live business address.

places.title: David Wills House
places.blurb: On the square, where Lincoln finished the Gettysburg Address the night before the cemetery dedication.

places.title: Sample ticket office
places.blurb: 100 Sample Street — concept placeholder, not a live storefront. Day walking and bus tours in this demo check in here.

places.title: Soldiers' National Cemetery
places.blurb: South of the square. The dedication ground of the Address, on the rise that became Cemetery Hill.

places.title: McPherson Ridge
places.blurb: Northwest of town. First-day ground: the opening fight on July 1, walked on the Highlights tour.

places.title: Seminary Ridge
places.blurb: The long western ridge. Confederate line after July 1, marked by the seminary cupola.

places.title: Cemetery Ridge
places.blurb: The Union fishhook. Walking tours cross this ridge to tie all three days into one story.

places.title: High Water Mark
places.blurb: The Copse of Trees on Cemetery Ridge — the farthest reach of Pickett's Charge on July 3.

places.title: Devil's Den
places.blurb: Jumbled boulders at the south end of the field. Close fighting on July 2, walked on the hike.
places.tourLabel: Little Round Top & Devil's Den Hike

places.title: Little Round Top
places.blurb: The rocky hill Union forces fought to hold on July 2. The hike climbs this ground.
places.tourLabel: Little Round Top & Devil's Den Hike

places.title: Big Round Top
places.blurb: The wooded height just south of Little Round Top, commanding the southern end of the field.
places.tourLabel: Little Round Top & Devil's Den Hike
